user.title: EEBUS devices discover
user.description: Select the IPv4 address of the Home Assistant host in the same LAN as the wallbox. No bridge or add-on is required.

data_description.interface_ip: For example 192.168.1.20; this is not the wallbox address.
data_description.scan_seconds: How long mDNS discovery is allowed to run.

select.title: Select EEBUS device
select.description: Choose the wallbox that should be paired.

pair.title: Pair EEBUS device
pair.description:
Device: {device}

Read the SKI from the EEBUS settings of the wallbox and enter it below. Then enable EEBUS pairing on the wallbox. Home Assistant verifies this SKI against the wallbox TLS certificate.

data_description.peer_ski: Exactly 40 hexadecimal characters; spaces, colons and hyphens are allowed.

error.cannot_connect: The EEBUS/TLS connection failed. Check pairing mode, network and SKI.
error.discovery_failed: mDNS discovery failed on this network interface.
error.interface_required: A valid IPv4 LAN address is required.
error.invalid_interface: Enter a valid IPv4 LAN address for the Home Assistant host.
error.invalid_ski: Enter the complete wallbox SKI with exactly 40 hexadecimal characters.
error.no_devices_found: No EEBUS SHIP device was found. Activate EEBUS/pairing on the wallbox and try again.
error.pairing_not_approved: The wallbox did not accept the connection within three minutes. Check its EEBUS pairing mode.
error.ski_mismatch: The entered SKI does not match the TLS certificate presented by the wallbox.

progress.wait_for_pairing: Connecting to {device} with wallbox SKI {peer_ski}. Keep the EEBUS pairing mode enabled on the wallbox.

abort.already_configured: This EEBUS device is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered SHIP service contains no usable port.
abort.interface_required: The Home Assistant LAN interface could not be determined.

error.invalid_interface: Enter a valid IPv4 LAN address for the Home Assistant host.
